title: fix(hooks-web): reset with searchAsYouType=false should search (algolia/react-instantsearch#3642)
body:
**Summary**

Similarly as algolia/react-instantsearch#802, when reset is triggered and searchAsYouType is false,
a search should still happen.

**Result**

fixes algolia/react-instantsearch#3641
